events.verdict: Goodwin (LAL) comes across Gordon's (DEN) wrist and pulls his hand off the ball, affecting his shot attempt near the basket.
Koloko (LAL) has a resting hand on Jokić (DEN), which he releases as he moves toward the pass.
Braun (DEN) has his hands forward when marginal contact occurs as Reaves (LAL) rips-through.
Koloko (LAL) grasps and then quickly releases Jokić's (DEN) jersey off-ball.
Koloko (LAL) brings his arm toward Jokić's (DEN) front and removes it when marginal contact occurs as they engage and separate on the perimeter.
Reaves (LAL) brings his right hand forward and cleanly dislodges the ball away from Jokić (DEN) as he starts his upward shooting motion.
Braun (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position as he jumps alongside Reaves' (LAL) path to contest the driving shot attempt.
Koloko (LAL) brings his left arm to Jokić's (DEN) side as Jokić grasps his right arm. Both players engage and separate.
Reaves (LAL) continues in a straight path after his pass when incidental contact occurs with Murray (DEN) in the lane.
Koloko's (LAL) arm is not vertical when the contact occurs with  Jokić's (DEN) arm, altering his shot attempt near the rim.
Koloko (LAL) rests a bent forearm on Jokić's (DEN) upper body and extends slightly as he releases to set the pick.
Koloko (LAL) places his hands on Murray's (DEN) side during the pick, and marginal contact occurs when he releases and rolls toward the basket.
Murray (DEN) has a resting hand on Reaves (LAL) during the drive, which he removes once Reaves enters his upward shooting motion.
Jokić (DEN) and Knecht (LAL) engage off-ball before the pick on the perimeter, and the contact is marginal.
Westbrook (DEN) and Goodwin (LAL) engage and disengage; marginal contact occurs off-ball before the steal.
